resources.string:
To mirror your phone:

1. Connect your phone to Android Auto.
2. Open the FermataX Mirror entry in the Android Auto launcher.
3. Unlock your phone and accept Android’s screen-capture confirmation.

If a permission request is pending, open FermataX on the phone to resume it.

Screen mirroring is available in the Android Auto version of FermataX.\n\nConnect that version to Android Auto, open FermataX Mirror in the car launcher, then confirm screen capture on the unlocked phone.
Your played content will appear here.
